# Shivansh Fulper — Portfolio

> Founder of Waldo and AI systems researcher building agents that can remember, act, and stay accountable over time.

## The thread

Shivansh started with multilingual data and model systems through Project EKA, then worked on production agents at Atlan. He is now building Waldo and has a longer-term interest in multimodal agents, physical AI, and robotics.

## Selected evidence

- Waldo and Kennel: working internal foundations for a user-owned personal agent. Current evidence is foundation-level, not market validation.
- Atlan: helped build and operate more than 30 production agent instances across context, tools, authentication, integrations, deployment, and reliability.
- Project EKA: built Eka Curator and worked on COOM within the broader IndiaAI Mission-backed program. Project scale is attributed to Project EKA, not to Shivansh's individual contribution.
- Agent harness research: studied more than 40 public harnesses and organized recurring architectural patterns. This was comparative research, not 40 production harnesses personally operated.
- Physical systems: Smart Manufacturing education and co-inventorship on published patent applications shaped a longer-term interest in physical AI.

## Research position

Machine execution is scaling faster than human understanding and responsibility. Waldo tests whether one user-owned relationship can preserve intent, evidence, correction, authority, and unresolved responsibility across changing agents and time.

The falsifier is explicit: Waldo should reduce sessions or raw artifacts opened per accepted outcome and interruptions per accepted outcome. External retention, revenue, willingness to pay, and product-market validation are not yet established.
